# Images used in the README

| File | What | How it is made |
|---|---|---|
| `banner.webp` | Banner at the top of the README | Background artwork generated with Higgsfield (model gpt_image_2_5) from a prompt that asked for no text; the title and lines of text were then set on top in Arial, so every word is spelled exactly. |
| `social-preview.jpg` | Picture shown when the repository link is shared (Settings → Social preview) | Same artwork and method as the banner, 1280 × 640. |
| `progress-light.svg`, `progress-dark.svg` | Progress chart in the README, in light and dark mode | Generated from the data by `tools/build_pages.py`. Do not edit by hand. |
